lines.beaver: 어머님, 오셨어요? 지호 진학 상담 시작할게요.
lines.beaver_en: Hello, you're here? Let's start Jiho's college counseling.
lines.beaver_roman: eomeonim, osyeosseoyo? jiho jinhak sangdam sijakalgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 선생님. 지호는 문과로 가고 싶어 해요.
lines.en: Yes, teacher. Jiho wants to go into the humanities track.
lines.roman: ne, seonsaengnim. jihoneun mungwaro gago sipeo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 지호는 글쓰기 상장도 많이 받았죠.
lines.beaver_en: I see. Jiho has received many writing awards, too.
lines.beaver_roman: geureokunyo. jihoneun geulsseugi sangjangdo mani badatjyo.
lines.en: Yes, in elementary school he attended a gifted program, too.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Do you have a target university in mind?
lines.learner: 명문대에 가면 좋겠지만 섣불리 정하진 않을래요.
lines.en: A top university would be nice, but I won't decide hastily.
lines.roman: myeongmundaee gamyeon joketjiman seonbulli jeonghajin aneullaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good idea. Have you looked into national scholarships?
lines.learner: 국가장학금을 받으면 큰 도움이 될 것 같아요.
lines.en: A national scholarship would be a big help.
lines.roman: gukgajanghakgeumeul badeumyeon keun doumi doel geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 성적이 좋으면 충분히 받을 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: With good grades, he can definitely get one.
lines.beaver_roman: seongjeogi joeumyeon chungbunhi badeul su isseoyo.
lines.en: That's a relief. I'll look into university dorms in advance.

lines.beaver_en: Doesn't Jiho seem tired at home these days?
lines.en: Jiho is both class president and library club head, so he's busy.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 전학 와서 적응도 정말 잘했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. He has adjusted really well since transferring.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. jeonhak waseo jeogeungdo jeongmal jalhaesseoyo.
lines.en: I am relieved. His old school used corporal punishment.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, so that was the reason.
lines.learner: 네, 이 학교는 예전 담임 선생님이 추천해 주셨어요.
lines.en: Yes, his former homeroom teacher recommended this school.
lines.roman: ne, i hakgyoneun yejeon damim seonsaengnimi chucheonhae jusyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good to hear. Do you have any other concerns?
lines.learner: 동생 취학 준비도 있어서 요즘 바빠요.
lines.en: I'm also preparing his sibling for school, so I'm busy these days.
lines.roman: dongsaeng chwihak junbido isseoseo yojeum bappayo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you for coming today. I'll be in touch.
